methods.label: Combine like terms first
methods.explanation:
Each of \(a,b,c,d\) appears positively in three parentheses and negatively in one. Thus each has total coefficient \(3-1=2\). The expression simplifies to
\[
\begin{aligned}
2(a+b+c+d)
&=2(1+10+100+1000)\\
&=2(1111)=2222.
\end{aligned}
\]
The answer is \(2222\), choice B.
methods.levelReason: Combining like terms before substitution keeps the calculation elementary and short.
